_about: Jordanes (6th c.), the Getica (Gothic History), in English. Lane B (classical and late-antique translations).

jordanes-mierow-getica-1908: The Origin and Deeds of the Goths (Princeton, 1908)

jordanes-mierow-gothic-history-1915: The Gothic History of Jordanes in English Version, with an introduction and a commentary (Princeton, 1915)

_collation.jordanes-mierow-getica-1908: Mierow's 1908 Princeton thesis version. The 1915 book gives the translation again with an introduction and commentary: 160 of 200 sampled 8-word runs of the 1908 text recur in the 1915 OCR, so it is largely the same translation (the misses are OCR noise or light revision, not separated). Both kept; one may be enough
